open_items: ESTAT list_dataflows timeout pattern: sixteenth episode, cycle 319, open as of this run (not yet confirmed resolved -- this run's cycle is the one where it appeared). Live recheck against ec.europa.eu directly returned HTTP 200 in 28.7s. All fifteen priors resolved within one cycle; watch cycle 320 for recovery. Standing recommendation (raise deadline, stream listing, or cache parsed result) remains open as a code-change-scope fix.

ABS gateway metadata empty-error-body flap: eighth occurrence at cycle 319 (gateway metadata: Error: , empty body, direct path healthy throughout), open as of this run. Live recheck against data.api.abs.gov.au directly returned HTTP 200 in 35.2s. All seven priors (most recently cycle 295, resolved by 296) resolved by the cycle immediately following. Watch cycle 320 for recovery. Empty error message itself still worth fixing under code-change scope (GatewayError/next_step in monitor/checks_gateway.py).

ABS and ESTAT gateway_issue coincided in the same cycle (319) for the first time on record. Each pattern is independently well established; could not determine whether this reflects a shared cause or is coincidence. Watch for a second simultaneous occurrence.

OECD gateway_issue 403 Forbidden episode (cycles 290-292, gateway list_dataflows and gateway data probe both HTTP 403, direct path healthy throughout): resolved by cycle 293, clean through cycle 319. First occurrence of this pattern for OECD, notable for spanning three consecutive cycles (~6h) when every other known gateway/direct flap in this repo has cleared within one cycle. Watch for a second occurrence; escalate for real if a future episode again spans more than one cycle.
